read.thesis: Clean 3Q26 print: RoTE ex-notables 18.2% and banking NII $11.7bn up 5%, but CET1 slipped to 13.9% and HTC&S unrealised losses widened to $5.0bn; no supply-side signal since HSBC is a bank.

triggers.label: Banking NII ≥$46bn held for 2026
triggers.quote: We continue to expect banking NII of at least $46bn in 2026.

triggers.label: NIM 1.57% stable YoY
triggers.quote: NIM for 3Q26 of 1.57% was stable compared with 3Q25.

triggers.label: CET1 13.9% down from 14.1%
triggers.quote: At 30 September 2026, our CET1 capital ratio decreased to 13.9% from 14.1% at 30 June 2026

triggers.label: HTC&S unrealised loss $5.0bn
triggers.quote: we recognised a pre-tax cumulative unrealised loss reserve through other comprehensive income of $5.0bn

guidance.quote: including a RoTE of 17% or better for 2026, 2027 and 2028, excluding notable items.
We continue to expect banking NII of at least $46bn in 2026.

guidance.metric: ECL charge as % of average gross loans 2026
guidance.quote: We continue to expect an ECL charge as a percentage of average gross customer loans of around 45bps
on track to deliver year-on-year growth in operating expenses of approximately 1% in 2026 on a target basis.
We intend to continue to manage our CET1 capital ratio within our medium-term target operating range of 14% to 14.5%.

red_flags.label: HK CRE credit-impaired $5.6bn
red_flags.quote: Hong Kong CRE 'credit-impaired' portfolio (excluding exposure to Chinese mainland borrowers) recorded further ECL allowances in the third quarter of 2026

red_flags.label: Single $0.5bn fraud-related UK exposure
red_flags.quote: including a $0.5bn fraud-related, secondary, securitisation exposure with a financial sponsor in the UK in our CIB business

red_flags.label: Unrealised HTC&S loss widened to $5.0bn
red_flags.quote: we recognised a pre-tax cumulative unrealised loss reserve through other comprehensive income of $5.0bn
